scope: Official NYC Jobs source freshness, deterministic strong-match admission, governed opportunity intake, and daily self-directed action digest
objective: Surface a deliberately small set of truthful, actionable opportunities while avoiding unnecessary model work and preserving Jamie's application authority.
gate_order: external, current, compensation, and specialist hard screens
fit, securability, and combined strong-match thresholds
governed opportunity record with human close-reading gate
role-specific evidence, materials, and synthetic hiring-reader checks
required_invariants: No raw job description is retained in generated reports or opportunity records.
No recipient address or provider credential is committed.
Staging and local environments cannot send email.
The open-data feed does not displace direct official-posting checks.
No score establishes eligibility, interview, offer, or hire.
cost_control: Deterministic checks precede any role-specific language-model evaluation; excluded and below-threshold rows do not receive hiring-reader calls.
activation_gate: Daily email delivery requires the workflow to be merged and the single-recipient Resend secrets to be configured by an authorized operator.
